fusions.name: Thread the Gap
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Throws a needle that deals 8 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Seam Ripper
fusions.desc: A thin thrust that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Darned Quick
fusions.desc: Restores 24 health to the ally who needs it most, with a 30% chance to heal critically.

fusions.name: Sharp After Supper
fusions.desc: When you gain health, your critical chance rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
